excluded: Pathogens, viruses, toxins or biological engineering
Hazardous synthesis and operational chemical recipes
Live ultrasound generation or transducer control
Exposure qualification or safe-state certification by the assistant
no_safety_inference: The paper calling 20 kHz inaudible is not an exposure-safety claim
A closed illustrative box does not establish an actual interlock
A stop command or disabled UI does not establish safe energy state
Successful data capture is not proof of intact support or custody
Reported voltages, distances and dimensions are historical facts, not safe operating limits
future_authority: Any actual equipment integration requires separate facility approval, qualified procedures, verified current state and permission. This packet supplies none.
